# C388 (inline) — boot_apply_plan must not run non-light fetches inline
Boot events run before the scheduler loop; limit_reasons (~9 min) and daily bars held the whole scheduler (and starved heartbeat until C382). Non-light plan items (and their dependents) are now returned as deferred/queued → guardiand creates fetch_item instances (existing path: phase whitelist, heavy mutex, 3 attempts + backoff, one alert). Light items still run inline in parallel. dry_run unchanged.
